author_or_account: Joint Data Center on Forced Displacement
title: Global Trends: statistical inclusion and self-reliance
discussion_signal: The post links forced-displacement trends to inclusion, self-reliance, and the visibility of refugees in national statistics. It shifts the discussion from counting movement alone toward whether host systems recognize displaced people as participants in public and economic life.
linked_research_question: How do displacement statistics, host capacity, inclusion, and self-reliance shape dignity and durable solutions?
limits: Institutional summary of a global report
No displaced-person testimony is visible in the post
Statistical inclusion does not itself establish service or livelihood outcomes
